outcome: cytological picture of the nasal mucosa
cohort: The study included 86 neonates born between 23 and 41 weeks of gestation, whose mothers were categorized as active smokers, passive smokers, or non-smokers based on questionnaires and maternal urine cotinine levels.
finding: Active and passive smoking during pregnancy did not significantly influence the cytological picture of the nasal mucosa of neonates, and no correlation was found between specific cell types and maternal cotinine concentration.
